purpose: Execute the atomic create-reference-axis operation within the MA-03 boundary: One geometry-reference line only. It does not create or attach a persistent DesignAxis or DatumLine.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires create-reference-axis and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: origin_mm
inputs.description: A finite point on the line, in millimetres.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: A finite nonzero line direction; the helper normalizes it.

preconditions: origin_mm and direction are three-element finite numeric vectors.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: An in-memory line reference returned by Line.Create.

postconditions: Line.Create(point_mm(origin_mm), direction(direction)) returns a line reference.

implementation.notes: Execute the atomic create-reference-axis operation within the MA-03 boundary: One geometry-reference line only. It does not create or attach a persistent DesignAxis or DatumLine. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.
